pages.title: Written by Hand
pages.text: Create a populated spell Scroll in a Scroll Forge.

pages.title: Written by Hand
pages.text: Choose what to learn instead of relying entirely on found scrolls.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use JEI for the installed forge recipe and supply its actual ink, paper and focus. Taking the forged nonempty scroll completes the task.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Scroll Forge needs ink, paper and school focus: focus selects school and ink limits rarity.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: School focuses have distinct acquisition routes; the focus determines available spells, not the color of a blank scroll.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Registered schools are fire, ice, lightning, holy, ender, blood, evocation, nature and eldritch. Historical Void/Poison names do not replace the registry.
